text:
Research & Publications
Quantitative macro notes, monetary policy transmission models, rate curve research, and correlations between short-term rates and trade financing.





Interest Rate Changes & Commodity Stocks


Methodology Note


Unveiling the lagged and contemporaneous relationships between interest rate cycles and commodity inventories: using time-series analysis to measure how trade financing conditions impact metal inflows across the world’s top trade hubs.

Coming Soon







Contagion Risks in Eurozone Sovereign Bonds


Quantitative Note


Measuring the pricing of contagion risks in the Eurozone bond market: applying time-series models to quantify the transmission and impact of higher core sovereign yields on periphery bond spreads.

title: Sno Research
text: Welcome to Sno Research. This is a future one-stop shop for data and analysis on money markets, financial plumbing, and macroeconomic frameworks. Separately, but not secondarily, Sno Research equally covers metals markets and their financial plumbing, liquidity managemnet, and their macroeconomic backdrop. Data and analysis are underpinned using quantitative methods in a transparent and rigorous form.
